title: Preparation inside the controller
statement: Let $C$ and $D$ be finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet, with positive numbers of work tapes, and choose states $c_e,c_x$ of $C$ and $d_e,d_x$ of $D$. For any Boolean input word $w$ and candidate word $s$, there is a time $t\le 5(|s|+|w|+3)$ at which the controller, started in its preparation phase with $s$ on the candidate tape and all other tapes blank, is in preparation phase $8$ with flag equal to the truth value of $|w|<|s|$, and has $s$ on both the candidate tape and the first width-bank tape and the suffix of $w$ after its first $|s|$ bits on the first length-bank tape, with all other tapes blank. No configuration from time $0$ through time $t$ has the anchor state.
hypotheses_covered: C and D are finite Boolean-alphabet Turing machines
C has a positive number of work tapes
D has a positive number of work tapes
ce and cx are states of C
de and dx are states of D
replaced:
For any input $w$ and candidate $s$, there is a time
$t \le 5(\abs{s} + \abs{w} + 3)$ such that the controller, from its
preparation seam carrying $s$, reaches the seam holding the candidate, its
copy, and the native suffix of $w$ after position $\abs{s}$, with the
past-the-end flag recording $\abs{w} < \abs{s}$; the trace avoids the
anchor.
